name: Build: Surface detail: normal maps, decals and contact shadows
body: Texture and normal map support, decals, and a blob/contact shadow under the player. One PR based on nox-proto, with before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Blob shadows done (D-070): composite-pass ellipses from the depth buffer, lantern::graphics::AddBlobShadow, platformer player uses it in place of the disc, guide docs/blob-shadows.md. Normal maps and textured decals are still to do; this card stays open for them.
